newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GPT's Fiji phone deal could be worth US$10 mln.
newsitem.headline: GPT's Fiji phone deal could be worth US$10 mln.

text.p: GPT Ltd, Britain's biggest payphone maker, said on Thursday it would supply digital transmission and telecommunications management systems to Fiji Telecom.
"The exact terms of the deal are not known, but it's somewhere in the region of US$10 million," a source close to the deal told Reuters.

"GPT is now the major supplier of synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH) and plesisynchronous digital hierarchy (PDH) products to Fiji Telecom," GPT said in a statement at the Asia Telecom 97 trade fair.
GPT provides network services to state-backed Fiji Telecom, connecting 750,000 people on the country's 100 inhabited islands. GPT claims to have a 33 market share of SDH and PDH products globally.
